name: Dinutuximab + Irinotecan + Temozolomide (D-I/T) (Relapsed/Refractory Neuroblastoma)

source.textbook: Principles and Practice of Pediatric Oncology, 8th ed.

institution.provenance: COG ANBL1221 Randomized Phase II Study (Mody et al. Lancet Oncol 2017)

premedications.name: Hydromorphone or Morphine continuous IV
premedications.notes: Mandatory: continuous opioid infusion during dinutuximab for neuropathic pain control

supportiveCare: Loperamide at first sign of loose stool after irinotecan (pediatric weight-tiered dosing)
Filgrastim (G-CSF) 5 mcg/kg/day SC starting day 7 until count recovery
Hydration and monitoring for capillary leak syndrome
monitoring: Vitals q15m during first hour of dinutuximab, then q30m-1h
CMP and electrolytes every 2-3 days during inpatient chemoimmunotherapy

drugs.name: Irinotecan
drugs.notes: Irinotecan 50 mg/m2/day IV over 90 minutes on Days 1-5.

drugs.name: Temozolomide
drugs.notes: Temozolomide 100 mg/m2/day PO once daily on Days 1-5 (administered on an empty stomach at bedtime or 1 hour before dinutuximab).

drugs.name: Dinutuximab
drugs.notes: Dinutuximab 17.5 mg/m2/day continuous IV infusion over 10-20 hours on Days 2-5 (total 70 mg/m2/cycle) with concurrent opioid analgesia per COG ANBL1221.
